title: callitriche terrestris subsp. subsessilis
intro: Callitriche terrestris subsp. subsessilis, commonly known as floating water-starwort, is a species of aquatic plant in the family Plantaginaceae. This plant is traditionally used in folk medicine for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antiseptic properties, which can aid in wound healing and reduce inflammation. The therapeutic actions of Callitriche terrestris subsp. subsessilis include antioxidant, antimicrobial, and anti-inflammatory effects, which may contribute to its traditional uses. Bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and other secondary metabolites that are responsible for its medicinal properties.
